programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with Heather, who says she is not at fault for her son's accidental overdose. But- where was she that night?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with Jamie, a fitness model who admits he has struggled with drug and alcohol addiction for years. Jamie’s brother, Anthony, says their parents have enabled Jamie at every turn -- including failing to acknowledge Jamie’s other serious problem, which he refuses to discuss. After storming off stage, Jamie rejoins the conversation. Is he ready to be completely honest with his family -- and with himself? Dr. Phil has a sobering wake-up call for Jamie -- and for his parents. Will Jamie finally get the help he needs to get clean -- and stay clean for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Richie Lewis was a three-time All-American, Hall of Fame college pitcher, who became one of Major League Baseball’s most electric personalities, striking out some of the game’s greatest players. But now, his wife Andrea and their three children claim since Richie was forced to retire from the majors due to an injury, Richie says his life has no purpose without baseball and he has no reason to live. Richie’s family claims his depression and alcoholism have led him to become a sloppy, blackout and abusive drunk, who has become a public embarrassment to himself and his family. Richie insists the only issue he is facing is depression from leaving the game he loved. Before coming to Dr. Phil, Richie demanded no one discuss his alleged alcoholism, and he threatened to walk out of their lives forever if they did not honor his demand. What happens when Richie finds out he is indeed part of an alcohol intervention? Plus, Richie’s college teammate Deion Sanders drops everything to fly to Los Angeles to surprise and help his dear friend. Will all this effort convince Richie that he needs help?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Steve is a raging alcoholic, and his wife, Sheila, violently abuses him when he drinks. Their two young daughters witness the fighting and are trapped in a war zone. Is it too late for this family to be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lynn and Paul say their 20-year-old daughter, Loni, went from a straight-A student to a heroin addict, and they’re desperate to get her help. Dr. Phil sends mother-son intervention team Debbie and Brandon to track down Loni and offer her a lifeline. Will she take it?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Toni says her daughter, Kristine, is battling an alcohol addiction and has resorted to drinking hand sanitizer as a cheap way to get her fix. Kristine says her family is dysfunctional, and they’re the reason she can’t stay sober. Dr. Phil has words of warning for Kristine. After three failed stints in rehab, will she agree to try again -- or risk losing her daughter forever?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When 24-year-old Andee last met with Dr. Phil, she was struggling with drug addiction -- and her parents, Pam and Ed, blamed each other. After the taping, Andee says she completed 90 days of rehab but later relapsed and is now worse than ever. Is she finally ready to commit to staying clean?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil takes a hard look into the life of identical twin sisters, Talia and Alissa, who say they are homeless and addicted to heroin, and that nothing seems to stop them from scoring drugs – no matter who it hurts. Watch as they share their daily lives with the Dr. Phil cameras and hear them discuss being 21-year-old “prostitutes” together, explain that they have stolen change from a blind man and once stole from over 50 residents at a nursing home, all to get money for heroin. Dr. Phil’s offer of help includes something so radical, it’s a Dr. Phil show first, surprising the twins, their family and the studio audience. But will Talia and Alissa accept the help offered to try to save their lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: "I wanted to make someone jealous." "I was bored." "I wanted to feel closer to God." These are just a few of the 237 reasons why women say they have sex. Author and clinical psychologist Dr. Cindy Meston and Dr. Jennifer Berman, a sexual health expert, join Dr. Phil to talk about women and sex, and offer advice to couples with differing libidos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman accused her ex-husband of molesting her daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the last 10 years, the number of women arrested for driving drunk has risen by 30 percent, and police report that more and more young children are sitting in the back seat when these moms are pulled over.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A 7-year-old boy's knives fascination and violent imaginary friend injured teachers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know someone who likes to pass the buck, point fingers and play the blame game, instead of taking responsibility and apologizing? Dr. Phil's guests are ready to confront a loved one who refuses to say they're sorry.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

Joni says she feels betrayed by Gina and her father, even going as far as sharing her dislike for her former friend and father’s newfound romance on TikTok. Gina says the picture Joni paints of them being best friends is all a lie, but in any event, Joni needs to accept her relationship with Joni’s father. David says despite his daughter’s disapproval, he is going to continue being in a committed relationship with Gina, but that doesn’t mean he can’t also have a relationship with his daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda says her husband of two years, Jeffrey, was recently caught in an online child sex sting and sentenced to five years in prison, yet she’s not sure if she should leave him. Why does she say she blames herself for what happened? And, hear from Amanda’s parents, Juliet and Timothy, who say they just want their daughter to move on. When Dr. Phil gives Amanda a harsh dose of reality, will she see the situation for what it is? Then, 18-year-old Seri says that two years ago, she fell in love with 26-year-old Hector, who convinced her to quit school and become a prostitute — and give him all the profits. Hector was convicted of sexual assault of a child and is now serving up to 30 years in prison. Seri is raising their daughter and has a new boyfriend, Will, but she admits that she would consider taking Hector back, if given the opportunity. Why does Seri say she still has feelings for her abuser?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Attention men: If you have a child on the way, or dream of being a father some day, you don’t want to miss this show! A little-known law could keep you from having any rights to your child. Bryce and Esther dated for one month before Esther became pregnant. Bryce says he wanted to marry Esther and raise their child together, but Esther says she wasn’t ready to be a mother. When they broke up, Esther decided to place the baby for adoption without informing Bryce. When Bryce finally learned his daughter was born, she was already seven days old and placed with another family. Now Bryce is fighting to get his child back, but because of an obscure law in some states, he has lost his rights as a father. What law did Bryce fail to comply with that even the lawyers in this case weren’t previously aware of? Is he unfit as a father, or is this law unconstitutional? Bryce and Esther’s lawyers give their opinion. Plus, the grandparents at odds over Esther’s decision face off. Don’t miss this heated discussion and learn more about the Putative Fathers Registry!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A 13-year-old's powerful and disturbing diary entries have Dr. Phil very concerned. Trisha says her daughter's pain stems from her father's discipline. How do you know if your discipline crosses the line into abuse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.desc: Darcy says that her sister, Jennifer’s, home is in a state of complete chaos. She says Jennifer and her husband, Ralph, have no rules, their kitchen is bare, the electricity is often shut off, and they put their needs ahead of those of their four children -- who are acting out as a result. Darcy says her nephews, 8 and 10, smoke marijuana, play with weapons and recently started a local forest fire -- and that the 10-year-old once wrote a note asking for someone to kill him in his sleep. She says her 12-year-old niece was recently called to truancy court, and her 16-year-old niece is having unprotected sex in the home with her older, live-in boyfriend. Ralph concedes that he’s struggling to provide for his family financially and has made mistakes as a parent, but says Jennifer is to blame, claiming she’s checked out as a mother. Jennifer admits she’s detached from her family, struggles with depression and has trouble maintaining the household. Nikki, Paige’s stepmom, thinks she and her husband should raise the child, because they can better provide for her, and she wants Paige to break up with Jordan. Why does she believe that Jordan is brainwashing Paige? The teen dad says Nikki is the one who’s controlling, and he’s stepped up to the plate. Will the families come to an agreement? See what Dr. Phil tells them they must do to ensure Miley grows up in a healthy environment. Plus, find out the 10 things teens want their parents to know about teen sex.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

But the married father of two refused to back down. When Tory broke down in tears, Kip finally agreed to find a calmer way to express his frustration. Just weeks later, Tory’s mother, Vicky, says the surly relationship has not only gotten worse, the hostility has escalated, and her patience is running thin. She says both Tory and Kip refuse to seek help, and now there is a new bombshell that is making their home life virtually unbearable. What does Kip say is his biggest issue with his stepdaughter? And, will this family finally agree to accept help and repair what’s left of their relationship? Then, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters. One of the girls has run away, and the other feels that he treats her like a slave. Can they resolve their disputes and come together as one? (FOLLOW UP FROM 9093)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Contemporary weddings have turned into five-star productions, with couples pulling out all the stops to shine on their special day. But what happens when the bride or groom-to-be starts making diva-like demands? Mike and Jamie agreed to a small Vegas wedding, but that went out the window when Jamie switched her gown three times, rented a limo to drive her one block and upgraded her engagement ring. Mike says that Jamie also made him uninvite all of his friends and cancelled his bachelor party! Are Jamie’s antics a hint of what’s to come in their marriage? Then, Nastassia complains that her husband-to-be, Richard, is cheap. She says he wants her to buy bridal flowers from the grocery store, have her mom sew her gown and even schedule the wedding before year's end so he can get a tax write-off! Will Richard’s tightwad ways force Nastassia to call off the wedding?

programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melinda and Amy claim their lives have been turned upside down by a social media influencer and political activist named Paloma, who they say has subjected them to nine months of cyberbullying and harassment. Paloma says they’ve got it all wrong and that she is the victim of their cyberbullying. Who is the real victim? Will Dr. Phil convince these three women to “log off” from each other? Find out in this explosive episode!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles two news stories that have captivated millions. First up, is it ever appropriate to confront your child’s bullies? That’s what James Jones says he did when he boarded his 12-year-old daughter, Chatari’s, school bus, and the video of his tirade went viral! James says some of the students terrorized his child, who suffers from cerebral palsy, and his actions resulted in two second-degree misdemeanor charges against him. CNN contributor Roland Martin joins the show, and he says James should be named Father of the Year for protecting Chatari, who was reportedly hit, called names and had condoms thrown at her. Roland goes head-to-head with attorney Areva Martin, who says James’s behavior was unwarranted. Did this dad cross the line? What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, the disappearance of David Hartley reads like a murder mystery. His wife, Tiffany, says they were on vacation when David was shot in the head by Mexican pirates while jet skiing. His body was never recovered, and Mexican authorities question if the event really occurred. Some people wonder if Tiffany was involved, but she maintains her innocence. Find out why she declined a lie detector test, and hear Dr. Phil’s strong message for her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, made headlines and were the subject of a Lifetime movie called Baby Brokers. The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? Sandy claims her biological parents “sold her like a piece of furniture for $5,000.” Find out what happens when Sandy meets her biological father for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom is supposed to love and nurture her children, but what if she's too involved? Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling, manipulative and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration, not mourning. He claims she uses bribes to control his every move, including offering him $20,000 to divorce his first wife. Margaret admits that she can be pushy and difficult but says she just wants to see her son succeed in life. Is she really setting him up for failure? Does Reed really want to man-up and break free from his mother's grasp? And, is Margaret willing to let him go? Then, 35-year-old Anthony, star of the new TLC reality show Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home and letting his mom, Patti, wait on him hand and foot. How does Patti feel about their living arrangement? Will she ever kick Anthony out? Plus, hear how Anthony's lifestyle affects his dating life. If you know of a mother-son bond that's a little too close for comfort, don't miss this Dr. Phil. Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration. Margaret says she wants to see her son succeed - but is she setting him up for failure? Plus, 35-year-old Anthony, star of TLC's Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Craig and Cherie say the last half of their 16-year marriage has been anything but happily-ever-after. Cherie says Craig is chauvinistic, verbally abusive and demands sex, which she admits she only gives him about three to four times a year. Craig says Cherie withholds sex to control him, and as a result, he has become a slave to his anger. Cherie fears the tension in their household is taking a toll on their 11-year-old daughter, who is often caught in the crossfire of their fighting. Dr. Phil challenges the couple to a communication test. Can they heal their wounds and rekindle their romance? Then, meet the couple who inspired the movie, The Vow. Shortly after Kim and Krickitt Carpenter were married, a terrible car crash changed everything. Krickitt lay in a coma for weeks, and awoke with no recognition of her husband. The couple shares their inspiring, though oftentimes heartbreaking, journey of falling in love all over again. How did they find their way back to each other? And what is it like seeing their lives played out on the big screen? If you’ve ever wondered whether love can survive the toughest of challenges, you won’t want to miss this show! This show contains strong sexual content. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, viewers met 21-year-old Bailey who says she has the greatest love story of the century. She says she met Jasmine on social media eight months ago and that it was love at first post. She says they’ve been communicating day and night but have never spoken on the phone and have never met. When Dr. Phil first tried to talk to Bailey, she became insistent that her mother, Ericka, not participate in the show, and Bailey angrily walked off the stage. Bailey decided to come back to tell Dr. Phil she wants to meet Jasmine for the first time because she has something important to tell her. Will Dr. Phil allow Bailey to meet the target of her obsession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The contentious 2020 presidential election has shown that there’s a clear divide in America – half the country is celebrating, and the other half is angry – making the upcoming holiday season especially tricky to navigate. Instead of being a time of joy, celebration and giving thanks, many families are faced with the dilemma of how not to argue with their own spouses, children and parents about politics. Dr. Phil meets a Republican father, who is barely speaking to his Democrat daughter after an argument they had over Donald Trump. Then, Dr. Phil meets another father, a lifelong Democrat, who says he raised his son to be a free thinker ... but never imagined that he’d support Trump! The election is officially over, but the drama remains. What’s Dr. Phil’s advice on how to move forward post- election without turning holiday dinners with family into a war zone over politics? Tune in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says she was instantly attracted to Jason, known as “Tank D.,” one of the stars of CMT’s hit show Redneck Island, and they started dating. But now, Jessica claims the man she loved for over 18 months is an arrogant, self-centered narcissist who cares more about partying and verbally trashing her than their 6-month-old baby son. programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: From the 17th century to the modern day, the Paris Police Headquarters Museum recounts the history of the Préfecture de Police. Chef Nicolas Beaumann lights up Maison Rostang with his two stars. Undercover: casual fashion with inbuilt style. From gravestones to contemporary decorative art, Benjamin Nicco carves stone.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Showcasing Olivier Barrois, master glassworker in all his splendour: when the possibilities offered by glasswork stretch to infinity and beyond. All about the turbulent history of the classic French recipe: coq au vin. Exhibition "Fashion and Sport, from one podium to another". How to wear gloves.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: She is an iconic fashion figure. A catwalk legend, she embodies French elegance. She is also passionate about art, and has rubbed shoulders with and inspired some of the world's greatest creators. Inès de La Fressange is our guest. We're also joined by Nadine Abdel Ghaffar, who had the brilliant idea of bringing together contemporary art and the ancestral heritage of pharaonic Egypt. The result is spectacular installations and monumental sculptures at the foot of the pyramids. Then there's Alex Vizorek's take on the Douanier Rousseau and Hector Obalk's look at the secrets of Georges de La Tour's work.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Mosaic artist Anne-Cécile Lopez brings her own interpretation to an age-old art, at the frontier between archaeology, geology and anthropology. Charlotte Franier restores old paintings.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Telling real from fake at the Paris Museum of Counterfeit Goods. Multi-talented designer with a passion for Paris, Marin Montagut takes us on a poetic journey. Pieter Mulier treads in the footsteps of the founder of Maison Alaïa. Fantastic animals and floral motifs on every finger with jeweller Fusako Koike.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Declerq Passementiers passes-on his know-how through high precision weaving techniques. All about the Noé, Louis Vuitton's emblematic bag. Mauviel glorifies the cuisine of both chefs and amateur cooks with its professional utensils. The western trend is on a roll.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Joëlle and Théo, qualified chemists, specialised in plants, have chosen a new life. They have traded in their white coats for organic farmer boots in a community farm in the Franches-Montagnes. A choice fed by their love of plants and one that they don't regret.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Avenue Marceau, Paris, the Yves Saint Laurent Museum is dedicated to the great French haute couture designer. Philip Chronopoulos is head chef, working beneath the arcades of the Palais Royal.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Alexis and Antoine are getting ready to cross the country in search of mountain biking communities in Canada. They are doing last-minute preparations before setting off for the mythical Shore, which lies to the north of Vancouver.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: In the heart of Le Marais, the Museum of Magic reveals its secrets. Between cinema and pop culture, Julien Fournié rolls out his fashion on the red carpet. With KidSuper, American Colm Dillane mixes fashion, dance, painting, music... Architectural shapes and clean lines, Caroline Desile's ceramics become contemporary totems.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Jewellery knows no limits, however bold, as we discover at the Timeless Jewels show dedicated to designers. All about eau-de-vie, that well-named "water-of-life". Ski and elegance combine in perfect harmony with innovative sports fashion from Fusalp. Borrowed from the world of dance, ballet flats are now available for men.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: Together with Franco-Lebanese painter Christine Safa, we look back at the highlights of the past artistic year: the incredible story of the Louvre heist, the artworks breaking all records at auction houses, and the crucial issue of art restitution... A close-up as well on the artists and exhibitions that made us dream in 2025. And let's not forget Alex Vizorek: he tells us everything you need to know about Henri Matisse.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: The Paris Philharmonia is home to a museum dedicated to music. Vincent Garnier Pressiat's audacious fashion style permeates the French capital.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Exploring the Dior Gallery. The designer Alphonse Maitrepierre finds inspiration in the problems of today for a resolutely optimistic fashion style. With Viktor & Rolf, ball gowns and acres of tulle are enough to make you spin. The costume workshops at the Bordeaux Opera House light up its dancers.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: The 2024-2025 autumn/winter ready-to-wear collections had everyone talking: a look back at the runway shows. Colette Maciet, renowned "head seamstress" for some of the greatest designers, publishes "Haute Couture, une vie aux côtés des plus grands couturiers". The designers from the Fashion Farm Foundation collective present the Paris fashion week.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Jo Fontaine wanted to be a farmer like his father, on the family land in his village near Geneva. But at 20, he discovered sculpture, and it was an "explosion in his head", a revelation. From the outset, he chose to express himself on stone, in sometimes monumental works.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: In her studio, plastic artist Morgane Tschiember works and experiments her chosen materials. Between fire and transparency, Thibaut Nussbaumer tames molten glass.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Few places have had such an impact in the cycling world as Vancouver's north shore mountains. This region called The Shore has inspired biking trail creators worldwide.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Architecture, art and design at the M-A30 or Museum of the 1930s. Through colourful objects Stefania di Petrillo explores the emotional dimensions of design. Junya Watanabe deconstructs fashion to build sculptural bridges between art and textile. Marion Flament takes the art of stained glass beyond its traditional borders.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Known as poor man's gold, Lison de Caunes has brought straw marquetry bang up-to-date! The iconic couture house Céline was originally created to dress little girls. A real enthusiast, Pascal Montfort collects magazines and catalogues to better understand the fashion world. All about how to wear hats and other headgear.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Anouk Hutmacher is an assistant nurse who has been covering the rural territory of Haute-Veveyse for fifteen years. She goes from farm to farm, helping old people to retain their independence. More than just physical care, she offers magnificent human encounters, sometimes funny, sometimes sad.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: The Hôtel de la Marine in Paris looks back over two hundred and fifty years of naval history. Multi-talented artist, Aurélie Galois paints industrial canvases made of rubber and small secret boxes.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Antoine and Alexis ride along a legendary route: the Sea to Sky Highway. In Squamish, they meet Christian Begin who takes them on a high-altitude adventure.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: From Rubens to Degas, exploring the Pau Fine Arts Museum collections. Self-taught and Michelin-starred, at Le Grand Véfour the chef Guy Martin looks back at his gastronomic career. An uninhibited celebration of materials and colour with Rahul Mishra. Amandine Antunez masters the art of stucco marble using plant dyes.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: A partnership between Dior and Mexican craftworkers produced a vibrant result that exploded onto the catwalk during Maria Grazzia Chiuri's latest runway show. All about the tribal origins of Jerusalem artichokes. An in-depth look at arts and crafts in Normandy, as celebrated by McArthurGlen Giverny. Wearing a leopard skin print.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: He is one of the great comic-book authors of our time. A brilliant illustrator, author of "L'Arabe du futur" and "Les Cahiers d'Esther", he captures childhood like no one else and has transformed his personal story into a universal work. Also a director, Riad Sattouf is our guest. We also have with us one of the greatest artists of her generation, who has conquered the most prestigious museums. Éva Jospin transforms cardboard, silk or bronze into monumental forests and landscapes, with exceptional technical mastery. And then David Hockney is on show in Belgium, at the Mons Museum of Fine Arts: this is Alex Vizorek's Vizorek'xpert column!

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: From the kitchens of the greatest chefs to that of the Lucas Carton Paris, we discover the Michelin-starred career of Hugo Bourny. Decorative painter, Éloïse d'Argent brings sublime style to ceilings and walls.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: A visit to the Domaine National de Saint-Cloud and its museum. Loose-fitting, flowing and transparent, the designer Arthur Avellano takes latex to new heights. For Yves Saint Laurent, Anthony Vaccarello returns to the roots of the brand. Stéphanie Trolez brings the art of straw marquetry to cabinetmaking.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: French expertise relies on its creativity, virtuosity, tenacity... An overview with Veronica Marucci, milliner; Hervé Bourdelle, last French maker of shoe lasts; Ramesh Nair, artistic director with Joseph Duclos. All about the pizza Margherita, French sake and lobsters. Concrete, metal sheeting, glass: the favourite materials used in contemporary design.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S11
programme.desc: Claude Konrad loves his town of Bienne and has decided to revive its industrial past. Because Bienne, a watchmaking and factory town, was full of companies, including the American General Motors. But Bienne is also home to factories of radiophonic machines, bicycles and pianos.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Worthy heir to the Nabi movement, the painter Nathanaëlle Herbelin opens the doors to his studio. Nature's organic forms are omnipresent in the works created by cabinet-maker Maxime Goléo.

programme.title: Partis rouler
programme.desc: Antoine introduces AndrŽane Lanthier-Nadeau to Alexis, who he met on the competition circuit. The threesome head off in search of the steepest trails on the Sea to Sky Highway in Pemberton.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: To Meudon and a private tour of Rodin's studio. Virginie Friedmann and Delphine Versace: a love story filled with sublime materials and unexpected surprises. Gucci's fashion garden brings bucolic effervescence and a touch of vintage to the 2025 cruise collection. Making the "chistera", exceptional know-how in the Basque country.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Welcome to the kingdom of creativity: the visionary refurbishment of L'Oréal's historic headquarters! All about the history of Adidas and Pumas' trainers: an internecine war. When ties and feathers are upcycled into clothing: encounter with Marion Oliver-Williamson, founder of MOW. Dare to be bold: wearing capri pants.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S08
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: He is a legend of French television, an iconic presenter, director and man of culture. Antoine de Caunes has influenced generations with his unique sense of irreverence. He comes to tell us about his relationship with art and to talk about "Antoine de Caunes, la vie rêvée d'un enfant du rock", the Canal+ documentary series. Also with us is Marguerite Li-Garrigue, one of the most promising artists on the contemporary scene: a unique universe, a rare intensity and a passion for insects, at the heart of delicate and powerful works. Canadian painter Kent Monkman as seen by Alex Vizorek, in the Vizorek'xpert column.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S09
programme.desc: Pastry chef and baker, for Benoît Castel sharing his culinary philosophy is a delicious pleasure. The craftsman Pascal Le Bonhomme recounts his enthusiasm for globes.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: The Cluny Museum recounts mediaeval art. Gastronomy on a plate with chef Victor Mercier: you don't need to travel far to discover new horizons! Bold, powerful and always sublime, Saint Laurent artistic director Anthony Vaccarello transforms women. Creations by ceramist Charlotte Castro.

programme.title: America's Most Haunted City
programme.desc: In 2002, the world's most funded, field research organization, The American Institute of Parapsychology, doted its highest honorarium, "America's Most Haunted City," on Savannah, Georgia, leaving many to ask, "What The Haunted?" With this documentary, 20 year, paranormal insider, Shannon Scott, addresses his own views of Savannah's long haunted heritage and through Scott's own unique lens, attempts to convey a message about this side of life in the city that millions of people visit annually because of its ghostly and mysterious reputation. Scott, having worked for the likes of "Scariest Places On Earth," "Ghosthunters," and others, captures discussion with real Savannahians, about what it really means to live long term with phenomenon such as poltergeist, spook lights, shadow people, and other moments with the unexplained. Shannon Scott fully narrates and the film is a combination of stunning visuals of historic Savannah and surrounding Low Country, and includes an extensive interview with Dr. Andrew Nichols, founder of The American Institute of Parapsychology, about his life's work and his perceptions about what led him to crowning Savannah, America's Most Haunted City!

programme.title: Unveiled

Discover a thrilling blend of scientific exploration, historical analysis, and captivating storytelling as "Unveiled" pushes the boundaries of human understanding and leaves audiences captivated by the mysteries of the universe.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.desc: Skinwalker Ranch is a 500 acre property in eastern Utah. It’s also supposedly one of the most haunted places on Earth. For 20 years, the ranch was owned by Robert Bigelow, a real estate millionaire obsessed with the paranormal. Bigelow claimed the ranch to be a hotspot for UFOs, poltergeists, and all kinds of monsters. But no evidence to support any of this has ever been presented.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Bucks County Paranormal Investigations was called in to investigate the beautiful and historic Plumsteadville Inn, Pipersville, PA. Lead investigator Eric Mintel joined by Dave Antonow, Dominic Sattele and Spirit Medium Karen T. Hluchan roamed the halls of this historic structure and encountered many paranormal energies. A discovery, unknown to the owner Matt George, made this investigation one of BCPI's favorite in Bucks County. Follow the clues as we unravel the Mysteries of the Plumsteadville Inn. Also, Eric gets a report of a recent UFO sighting by a woman in Doylestown PA that was not only excited by what she saw but also frightened by it. Eric Mintel and Dominic Sattele meet with Leslie and talk about her report and try to find clues as to what it could be. What follows is a journey into the unknown as more UFO reports ramp up in the same area. What are people seeing!? Eric Mintel Investigates: UFO's over Doylestown PA.

programme.title: Classic Canadian Sasquatch Stories
programme.desc: For as long as human beings have braved the mountain passes and rugged trails of the Canadian Rockies, stories have been told of a huge, elusive, man-like creature that haunts the slopes. Though scarcer and more obscure than its famous West Coast counterpart, this mysterious alpine monster has nonetheless found its way into foundational ethnological treatises on Canada’s First Nations, and into seminal works on the Sasquatch phenomenon. In this episode, we will delve into classic legends of and encounters with the wildman of the Canadian Rockies.

programme.title: Romeo and Isabella
programme.desc: Trans woman, Isabella, has struggled to find the right man. When she goes back home, old friends and skeletons come back to find her. When she falls for Romeo, the neighborhood bad boy, they both find out falling in love may be a death sentence.

programme.title: My New BFF
programme.desc: Jasmine becomes friends with Lisa, her new neighbor and current law student. Their relationship turns toxic when Lisa develops an obsession with Jasmine, putting her life, her friends, and family in danger.

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Knee Deep
programme.desc: A young woman goes through a transformation to become a force to be reckoned with after witnessing a traumatic event. After learning about the game from her boyfriend and the art of the hustle, lies and deceit begin to tear her world apart.

programme.title: She Time
programme.desc: Krystal, a devoted wife and mother, finds herself trapped in the routine of a her daily life and a fading marriage. Longing for excitement and passion, she embarks on a girls’ night out that unexpectedly reignites an old flame from her past.

programme.title: Sinful Paradise: Welcome to Paradise
programme.desc: Follows the women and operators of Paradise, one of the hottest gentleman’s club in Atlanta, with high profile clients and beautiful women, and one of the only female owned clubs in the city. The owner, Cat, and her business partner SP protect their dynasty, and follows the stories and obstacles of its dancers.

programme.title: The Ring Widow
programme.desc: Crystal and Sean find out that they are renting out one of their airbnb properties to a possible serial killer targeting married men that cheat on their wives.

programme.title: A Matter of Heart
programme.desc: Balen, a successful family man, risks everything for a reckless affair. His wife, Krista, faces a harsh reality as her sacrifices are tested. Enter Latricia, a ruthless temptress with no shame. A story that weaves a tale of emotional turmoil, family crisis, unwavering faith, and the destructive power of temptation. Will love or lust prevail?

programme.title: A Wonderful Lie
programme.desc: Fading romance author Rebecca Sinclair concocts a desperate plan to reignite her dwindling career and fractured marriage. She creates a web of lies and her twisted plot leaves her trapped in a nightmare of her own making. Rebecca must scramble to keep control or risk being consumed by the very deception of her own doing.

programme.title: Only 48
programme.desc: When Tracy Harris is abducted and held for ransom, her father Keith has only 48 hours to deliver $500,000. Forced back into the criminal world he tried to escape; Keith faces dangerous alliances and hidden truths in order to save his daughter.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: Deliveries From Eva
programme.desc: Disgraced music star Reese is surprised to learn that he still has a fan in the form of delivery driver, Eva. The two form an unlikely friendship that begins to sour due to Eva's growing obsession and her struggles with PTSD.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her. Will she make it out of this relationship alive?

programme.title: Murder Gardens 2
programme.desc: After serving 10 years in prison, Chase returns to Miami Gardens with a goal of reclaiming his life. But the criminal empire that he was once part of has changed and his older brother Rell is now one of the heads in charge. He recruits Chase for one last job, but things are about to spiral out of control.

programme.title: Money Gang Lit
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.title: And They Named Her Love
programme.desc: Love, a hopeless romantic painter, sets out on a cross country journey to find herself in the competitive world of artistry. When a near death experience brings Atlanta based songstress Nasada into her life, she goes on a journey to find out that love and business do not always mix.

programme.title: Office Secrets
programme.desc: Alvin work at a grueling corporate job, where he is constantly under foot of his drug addicted, gambling boss. He crosses paths with Victoria, who recently freed herself from a betrayal from her husband, but has an agenda all her own. Alvin plans to pull the curtain back on his boss, but has to watch his toes going against Victoria.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: After an argument with her emotionally abusive step-father, a smart 19-year-old woman from rural Georgia hastily moves to Atlanta with hopes of staying with a friend. Motivated by the social justice movement of 2020, she wants to work for Stacy Abrams and register people to vote. After an argument with her friend, she finds herself suddenly homeless and must survive on the mean streets of Atlanta by any means necessary.

programme.title: Dream on Dreamer 2
programme.desc: Derrick attempts to break it off with his side-chick Keisha, but she thought she was his one and only. That is until she finds out about his fiancé Crystal. To get revenge, Keisha decides to befriend Crystal.

programme.title: Her Other Man
programme.desc: Looking to spice up their marriage, Kennedy invites another man, Billy, into the bedroom with her husband Ronny. When Billy is found dead, Ronny is being questioned about his murder.

programme.title: Bruised 2
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her husband, Kayla Brown has rebuilt her life following the launch of her successful memoir. she is then visited by a stalker, who is hell-bent on making her pay for what she has done in order to escape her husband.

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 “for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: I Hate I Love You
programme.desc: Jacinda and Bradley Wright are Managing Partners of a media company. Over the past year, they have enjoyed unprecedented success, but it comes with a price. From betrayal to illegal activity, both love and business are being destroyed by motives that cause everyone to have an agenda and everyone to have something to gain or lose. The old saying “Keep your Friends close and your enemies closer” are the truest words one can ever speak.

programme.title: Smash and Dash
programme.desc: Clarence, a Chef from Chicago, is very passionate about two things, food and love. After being jilted at the altar, Clarence's friends Lakeith and Buddy, immediately urge him to get back into the dating pool, but under one condition, and that is for him to "Smash and Dash.” Clarence needs to hook up with as many women as he possibly can through a dating app without falling in love.

programme.title: 1-800 Missing
programme.desc: Driven by the disappearance of his daughter, Kevin, an undercover cop, vows to bring her home. Chicago's missing become his personal mission. He joins forces with his partners, determined to take down the toughest kidnappers and reunite all the missing children with their families.

programme.title: A Masquerade Trapp
programme.desc: This pastor is a pimp; hustling through Christian dating apps. His pimp game is strong, and he's loved by all the ladies of the night. Until another pimp's woman leaves him, to be with the pastor. From the pulpit to the strip, pimpin' ain't easy.

programme.title: Abandoned at Birth 2
programme.desc: On a quest to learn more about her birth mother. A woman endures societal challenges, heartache, and more obstacles on a journey to find the truth.

programme.title: Art of Love
programme.desc: After a government contracted hit goes wrong, the collateral damage causes Lucas Alba to retire from working for the company. He may be done, but his past eventually catches up with him. The ensuing consequences put the life of him, and anyone close to him in Jeopardy.

programme.title: 10 Reasons Why Men Cheat
programme.desc: In the wake of a wedding catastrophe, three couples discover the meaning of commitment, while discussing what women want to know most of all when it comes to men and relationships. WHY DO MEN CHEAT?

programme.title: Below the Belt
programme.desc: Childhood best friend Crim and David fall in love and marry Jackie and Lakeisha, who are also best friends. David and Lakeisha’s marriage is on the rocks after lack of intimacy, while Jackie and Crim are doing amazing. Some time passes and it’s revealed that Lakeisha and Crim are having an affair. Lies, betrayal, and pain are thrown around. Will these marriages and friendships survive?

programme.title: Boxed In
programme.desc: Ria is an up and coming female boxer whose one and only focus is to be the best boxer alive. That's until she meets Tuga, who shows her that a life without love really isn't a life at all.

programme.title: Boxed In 2
programme.desc: After overcoming insurmountable odds, Ria finds herself a rising boxing star. She has everything she could ever imagine with the exception of one thing: love. She meets El by chance and starts to let go of her past disappointments and grab ahold of hope for the future. But with anything, nothing is ever as it seems. Faced with new revelations, Ria will have to decide if it's worth fighting for the sport she believes in and most importantly, the one she believes in.

programme.title: Dangerous Thirst
programme.desc: When Royelle's husband, Trevion, proposes delving into the swinging lifestyle, she reluctantly agrees, igniting a tumultuous sexual journey. What starts as a tantalizing exploration of their desires soon transforms into a journey fraught with jealousy, distrust, and emotional turmoil, threatening to unravel the very fabric of their marriage as she begins to find herself in a sex scandal, engulfed by lies, betrayal, and murder.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Too Little Too Late
programme.desc: James “Honcho” Young II is a well-respected boss but his position is threatened by his ex-love, turned partner, Ryan “Rain” Mills who desperately wants to be next in line. Driven by jealousy, love and money, Rain sets her sights on taking what’s hers, causing Honcho to lose more than just his position. Can she afford the cost to be boss?

programme.title: Condemn
programme.desc: College student, Quan, is presented with an opportunity too good to turn down. When she lets her sister, Bree, in on the deal, she takes it to the next level. Soon Quan realizes they both are in too deep, and is faced with the consequences.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: One of the hallmarks of modern quilting is the creative use of negative space. Audrey Esarey shares her thoughts on how to use negative space to highlight motifs. Then, Ebony Love has a lesson on partial seams – learn this technique and you will be surprised just how much you use it. Learn about chain piecing in the machine tip with Eliane Bergmann. You can chain piece an entire quilt!

programme.desc: This week's quilt radiates piece and love. Angela uses color placement for a heart-shaped quilt that's easier to make than it looks. IMPORTANT NOTE: The "Piece & Love" quilt designed by Audrey Mann and Dianne Brinton is no longer included with the class.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: There are many sources for inspiration when choosing a sewing project. Sometimes we find the perfect pattern or silhouette, and sometimes it's a special occasion we want to sew for, other times we simply love a particular fabric and look for something to make out of a gorgeous cut. But each fabric has characteristics that require different techniques. We chose 3 fabrics today and projects that are unique to the fabric chosen. First, Angela shows her technique for needle felting on silk. Next, Tina Givens introduces us to one of her favorite fabrics -- linen. She has some tips for quilt blocks that tell a unique story. Then, Angela returns for free motion techniques on cotton.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Metal comes in so many shapes and forms. Explore two very different types on this episode. First, Leslie Rogalski creates a centerline bracelet, the actual bracelet is pre-shaped chevron metal with holes and and an opening to string seed beads. Then, Tammy Honaman has another metal clay lesson.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Renovate the surface of your pages. Julie Fei-Fan Balzer adds depth to her designs with amazing shrinking embellishments. May Flaum creates dynamic designs with misty effects using scraps. Ashley Horton has a tip for storing tiny letters and embellishments. Cheryl Boglioli makes 3-D designs with fringed fabric and felt.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Combine materials, mediums and techniques to create a collage. Julie Fei Fan Balzer has a collage project using layers of stencils. Urban artist Seth Apter die cuts components for an industrial-looking collage. Mixed media artist Rebekah Meier paints, stamps and sews a colorful cloth banner. Jenn Mason has a tip for capturing images while you travel.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: As the war ended, women wore more tailored garments and pants. Fabric was readily available and flounces and drape became important design details to soften the masculine look. Sewing expert Londa Rohlfing shows how to make flounces for a truly feminine touch and Angela Wolf makes trendy cropped pants with a hidden zipper and great waistband treatments.

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: Did you know there is more than one way to do a yarn over? Yup, there are actually four! This week Tracey and Jodi demonstrate all four techniques and talk about when to use each.

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: Having trouble with your Fox Paws scarf? Well, you're not the only one! Luckily, designer Xandy is here to share her tips and tricks for navigating her famously intricate pattern.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Today's show is all about texture -- texture is the feel or shape of a surface or thing. It's the smoothness or roughness, or maybe how soft or hard. We will learn about texture with a Paleolithic cave painting, a fun pony corral, and a friendly but prickly hedgehog. Learn how to add texture to your drawings with ordinary things from around the house in the Art Journal segment. Last, make a furry friend with giant chenille stems.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: When creative ideas pop up, write them down. Make a colorful pocket journal with Jenny Barnett-Rohrs. Candie Cooper shares creative tips for handwriting and Franz Spohn writes with clay. Katie Hacker decorates for fall with a shining pumpkin luminary from blogger Carissa Bonham.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Artist Catherine Bickford presents ideas for meaningful gifts, including the symbolism of color and design motifs. Catherine discusses the meaning and symbolism behind various design motifs and materials. She shows how to combine themes, materials, techniques and motifs to create a talisman necklace that has significance and well-wishes for the recipient. Fair trade beaded bangles are featured on Katie's Beading Lesson.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Connect your designs in new ways. Warm up as host Katie Hacker designs with colorful stones. She adds beads and metal spacers to enhance the stone elements in necklaces. Author Lisa Crone works out with memory wire to create a sparkling necklace. Then, she cools down by making matching earrings.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Make technology your friend. It's hard to keep up with each and every new trend but you can find your favorites and use them to your advantage. We begin with an awesome page, then it's a project life page with Nancy Nally using instagram photos, and finally a family heirloom with modern techniques but historic info from Paula Nelson-Hart. Great for young family members to get to know their heritage and for older family members to remember and reflect.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: An artist sees things differently -- they have a unique way of looking at the world and interpreting it into art. First, we look at Mary Cassatt, an American painter and printmaker known for her portrayal of women and children and create a project showing the bonds between mother and child. Using a totally different perspective, Joe Rotella, creates a kaleidoscope guaranteed to alter the way you see the world. We finish up with Ardith Goodwin and a Kandinsky inspired work -- starting with a photo of a house and using chalk and neon to create her canvas.
